SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', sub.total_id, 'geometry', sub.geom_json::json, 'properties', json_build_object( 'total_id', sub.total_id, 'fclt_nm', sub.fclt_nm, 'inst_nm', sub.inst_nm, 'daddr', sub.daddr, 'facility_condition', sub.facility_condition, 'repair_required_yn', sub.repair_required_yn, 'emd_cd', sub.emd_cd, 'office_work_status', sub.office_work_status, 'office_work_complete_date', sub.office_work_complete_date ) ) ), '[]'::json) )::text FROM ( SELECT f.total_id, f.fclt_nm, f.inst_nm, f.daddr, f.facility_condition, f.repair_required_yn, e.emd_cd,
CASE WHEN f.repair_required_yn = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(w.work_status, 'PENDING') END AS office_work_status, CASE WHEN f.repair_required_yn = 'Y' THEN to_char(w.complete_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS office_work_complete_date, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geom) AS geom_json FROM qfield.facility_total_view f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT emd_cd FROM public.g_emd e WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) e ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT w.work_status, w.complete_date FROM map.facility_office_work w WHERE w.total_id = f.total_id AND w.use_yn = 'y' ORDER BY w.work_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) w ON true WHERE f.use_yn = 'y'
AND e.emd_cd LIKE #{code} || '%'
ORDER BY f.fclt_nm, f.total_id ) sub

SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', sub.total_id, 'geometry', sub.geom_json::json, 'properties', json_build_object( 'total_id', sub.total_id, 'fclt_nm', sub.fclt_nm, 'inst_nm', sub.inst_nm, 'daddr', sub.daddr, 'facility_condition', sub.facility_condition, 'repair_required_yn', sub.repair_required_yn, 'emd_cd', sub.emd_cd, 'office_work_status', sub.office_work_status, 'office_work_complete_date', sub.office_work_complete_date ) ) ), '[]'::json) )::text FROM ( SELECT f.total_id, f.fclt_nm, f.inst_nm, f.daddr, f.facility_condition, f.repair_required_yn, e.emd_cd, CASE WHEN f.repair_required_yn = 'Y' THEN 'PENDING' END AS office_work_status, NULL::text AS office_work_complete_date, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geom) AS geom_json FROM qfield.facility_total_view f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT emd_cd FROM public.g_emd e WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) e ON true WHERE f.use_yn = 'y'
AND e.emd_cd LIKE #{code} || '%'
ORDER BY f.fclt_nm, f.total_id ) sub

SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', f.total_id, 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geom)::json, 'properties', (to_jsonb(f) - 'geom') || jsonb_build_object( 'emd_cd', adm.emd_cd, 'emd_nm', adm.emd_nm, 'sgg_cd', adm.sgg_cd, 'sgg_nm', adm.sgg_nm, 'sido_cd', adm.sido_cd, 'sido_nm', adm.sido_nm ) )::text FROM qfield.facility_total_view f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.emd_cd, e.emd_nm, s.sgg_cd, s.sgg_nm, si.sido_cd, si.sido_nm FROM public.g_emd e LEFT JOIN public.g_sgg s ON s.sgg_cd = SUBSTRING(e.emd_cd, 1, 5) LEFT JOIN public.g_sido si ON si.sido_cd = SUBSTRING(e.emd_cd, 1, 2) WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) adm ON true WHERE f.total_id = #{totalId} AND f.use_yn = 'y'

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'code', sido_cd, 'name', sido_nm, 'extent', json_build_array( ST_XMin(env), ST_YMin(env), ST_XMax(env), ST_YMax(env) ) ) ), '[]'::json)::text FROM ( SELECT sido_cd, sido_nm, ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(geom), 3857) AS env FROM public.g_sido ORDER BY sido_cd ) sub

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'code', sgg_cd, 'name', sgg_nm, 'extent', json_build_array( ST_XMin(env), ST_YMin(env), ST_XMax(env), ST_YMax(env) ) ) ), '[]'::json)::text FROM ( SELECT sgg_cd, sgg_nm, ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(geom), 3857) AS env FROM public.g_sgg WHERE sgg_cd LIKE #{sidoCd} || '%' ORDER BY sgg_cd ) sub

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'code', emd_cd, 'name', emd_nm, 'extent', json_build_array( ST_XMin(env), ST_YMin(env), ST_XMax(env), ST_YMax(env) ) ) ), '[]'::json)::text FROM ( SELECT emd_cd, emd_nm, ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(geom), 3857) AS env FROM public.g_emd WHERE emd_cd LIKE #{sggCd} || '%' ORDER BY emd_cd ) sub

SELECT json_build_object( 'totalId', total_id, 'sourceTable', source_table, 'paths', json_build_array(photo_1, photo_2, photo_3, photo_4, photo_5, audio_memo, video) )::text FROM qfield.facility_total_view WHERE total_id = #{totalId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'iconType', icon_type, 'label', icon_label, 'keywords', COALESCE(keywords, ARRAY[]::text[]), 'glyph', glyph_svg, 'pinColor', pin_color, 'warnColor', warn_color, 'isDefault', is_default ) ORDER BY sort_order, icon_type ), '[]'::json)::text FROM map.facility_icon WHERE use_yn = 'y'
